symbols.name: IsClassTalentSpell

symbols.name: IsCurrentSpell

symbols.summary: Returns true if the spell is an 'empower' type spell that is cast by pressing and holding, with the on-release cast typically being affected by time held

symbols.name: IsPvPTalentSpell

symbols.name: IsSpellCrowdControl

symbols.summary: Returns true if the spell can be cast on hostile targets

symbols.name: IsSpellHelpful
symbols.summary: Returns true if the spell can be cast on the player or other friendly targets

symbols.summary: Returns true if the spell is considered important. For example a spell that's lethal if not interrupted would be considered important.

symbols.name: IsSpellUsable

clientDocumentation: An object that manages a collection of integer keys, each scheduled to signal at a specific time.
When a key's time arrives it is removed from the map and passed to the map's callback, letting you track many keyed deadlines through a single callback rather than scheduling each one individually.
